evidence_policy.candidate: The fixture is a deliberate structural candidate or minimized error boundary, but its VP8L internal state is not proven by Pillow.
evidence_policy.malformed_parser: Malformed witnesses record independent-parser rejection codes, phases, and bit offsets; these are specification evidence and never alter the Pillow error oracle.
evidence_policy.pillow_outer_result: The named row proves only the Pillow-observable pixels, bytes, metadata, or error result asserted by the matrix.
evidence_policy.structural_witness_needed: An independently checked VP8L parser or retained source provenance is required for any property not covered by structural_witnesses; Pillow outer rows alone never prove internal state.

properties.gap: The independent parser proves exact VP8L header dimensions and transform records for two standalone successful rows and confirms the embedded VP8L header/transform in one Pillow-tolerated ANMF-width row; it does not prove the outer ANMF dimensions. Other VP8L headers, transform orderings, and stream states remain outside this witnessed scope.

The independent parser now proves all 17 distinct transform sequences present in the 39-row successful lossless corpus, including no-transform, every observed color-indexing size, four predictor-plus-color size pairs, and three subtract-green combinations. Transform sequences not present in this corpus and malformed or repeated-transform forms remain outside this scope.

The independent parser now proves the predictor-mode map for the 19 named decode streams and the indexed encode artifact, covering every mode value observed in this fixture set. Rows without a predictor transform (mode0, quadrants, sparse, and steps) and complete coverage of every predictor-transform combination remain open.

The independent parser now proves that the four named candidate streams contain no predictor transform: mode0 and the quadrants/sparse streams have no transforms, while steps uses color indexing only. Other no-predictor streams and every legal predictor-transform combination remain outside this witnessed scope.

The independent parser now proves every named color-indexing band boundary (1, 2, 4, 16, 17, 32, 64, and 256); unlisted table sizes remain represented by those inclusive bands and are not claimed individually.

The independent parser now proves the color-transform record and every observed block-size boundary (2, 3, and 9 bits) for the listed rows; other transform selections and sizes remain outside this witnessed scope.

The independent parser now proves the subtract-green transform in the pinned Pillow encode artifact; the property remains limited to this witnessed encoded-output form and does not claim every encoder option or image shape.

The independent parser now proves the named meta-Huffman group forms (one and two groups), the observed 2- and 6-bit prefix widths, and their selected prefix streams; other group counts and prefix assignments remain outside this witnessed scope.

The independent parser now proves the explicitly listed entropy-image dimensions (2×1, 3×3, and 24×24) and their two-group forms; other dimensions and grouping patterns remain outside this witnessed scope.

The independent parser now proves every successful color-cache width observed in the 39-row lossless corpus (1, 3, 4, 5, 7, and 10), with lookup activity on the added widths. Widths 2, 6, 8, 9, and 11 are not present in this corpus, and malformed cache forms remain a separate candidate property.
The independent parser now proves simple-tree forms for the three listed successful rows; empty/malformed trees and other simple-tree alphabets remain outside this witnessed scope.
The independent parser now proves full-tree forms for the two listed high-entropy rows; malformed and other full-tree alphabets remain outside this witnessed scope.

The independent parser now proves the listed successful plane-distance mappings, including clamp behavior (10→1), coordinate mapping (5→16 and 24→4), a full-width mapping (23→256), and the direct-distance branch (152→32); malformed distance streams and other mapping entries remain outside this witnessed scope.

The independent parser now proves the five listed malformed transform forms by rejection code, phase, and bit offset; the Pillow error rows remain outer-result evidence and other malformed forms remain outside this witnessed scope.
The independent parser now proves the nine listed malformed Huffman boundaries by rejection code, phase, and bit offset; the broader malformed corpus remains outside this witnessed scope.
The independent parser now proves the three listed malformed cache boundaries by rejection code, phase, and bit offset; successful cache widths and other malformed forms remain separately scoped.
